# Robin Francis - Full AI Context

Canonical website: [https://robinfrancis.in/](https://robinfrancis.in/)

## Entity Summary

Robin Francis is an AI product builder, software engineer, and community leader from Kerala, India. His portfolio focuses on accessible technology, applied AI, local-first web products, assistive technology, and community leadership systems.

## Primary Claims

- IEEE Region 10 Outstanding Volunteer Award 2024 recipient, listed by IEEE Region 10.
- IBM watsonx GenAI Challenge second-prize team member for SoulSync, covered by The Week.
- 3x hackathon winner across GenAI, sustainability, and game development competitions.
- Founder and lead of TechX Infinia, an IEEE Computer Society flagship event with 450+ participants.
- IEEE Sahrdaya Student Branch Chairperson, helping grow the branch from 110 to 534 members and supporting 136+ programs.
- Builder of Argus, BulkyFi, and the official STRIDE Kerala website.
- Raised $2,650+ for community-impact projects.
- National bronze medalist in .22 rifle shooting at the NCC Thal Sainik Camp, 2017.
- Organiser of Codex Nightline, an AI build sprint held inside a moving Kochi Metro, covered by The Hindu BusinessLine.
- Co-lead of IEEE Region 10's first international Virtual Career Fair: 245 registrants, 31 global recruiters, 2,578 booth visits, 310 applications.
- Junior Programme Executive at K-DISC in the Social Enterprises and Inclusion division.

## Featured Projects

- [Argus GitHub repository](https://github.com/robinfrancis186/argus.git): local-first autonomous QA browser agent that scouts web apps, understands product flows, deploys synthetic users, and returns evidence-backed bug reports.
- [BulkyFi live app](https://bulkyfi.vercel.app/): local-first bulk certificate generator for templates and recipient spreadsheets, with browser storage and PDF/PNG export.
- [BulkyFi GitHub repository](https://github.com/robinfrancis186/bulkyfi)
- [STRIDE Kerala](https://stride.kerala.gov.in/): official website for an inclusive innovation initiative focused on assistive technology and social impact.
- SoulSync: AI companion concept for cognitive wellness using facial recognition, emotion tracking, and memory recall workflows for elders and caregivers.
- FoodLoop: AI platform concept for responsible food redistribution using machine learning surplus prediction to reduce food waste.

## Education

- B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, Sahrdaya College of Engineering & Technology, 2021-2025, CGPA 7.17.
- Higher Secondary, Computer Science, National Higher Secondary School, 2019-2021, secured 96%.
- Secondary School Certificate, Don Bosco High School, 2019, secured 100%.

## Focus Areas

- Artificial intelligence and machine learning.
- Generative AI and computer vision.
- React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase.
- Accessibility-centered technology and social-impact engineering.
- Local-first web applications and autonomous QA tooling.
- Community leadership, mentorship, and technical event strategy.

## Website Implementation

- Canonical website: [https://robinfrancis.in/](https://robinfrancis.in/)
- Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Sanity Studio, Resend, Vercel.
- Contact form sends through a Resend-backed API route.
- Public routes include home, projects, achievements, press kit, blog, blog posts, gallery, and card pages.
- SEO/AEO coverage includes canonical URLs, generated sitemap, robots, JSON-LD, Open Graph, Twitter cards, x-default hreflang, and crawler-visible fallback summaries.
- Security headers are served through Vercel, including CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer Policy, and Permissions Policy.
